description: This file contains CSS styles for a two-player Tic Tac Toe game's frontend, implementing theme management through CSS variables.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main container for the application, styling it for center alignment and background color based on the theme.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles for the header section of the application, including flexbox layout for centering and background management.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for links within the application, including color transitions based on the theme.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the theme toggle button, featuring positioning, padding, colors, and responsive adjustments.
